scope: Read-only analysis; no node or code changes

conclusion.mechanism: At epoch 37 phase 100, historical Work-ticket verification starts on all nodes. Block validation waits for Work proofs; blocks queue, nodes exceed the 400 ms producer timeout and take over from different parent blocks. Reorganizations and block verification backlog then grow.
conclusion.trigger_phase: Election proof verification within epoch 37; epoch transition occurs after the stall.
conclusion.cpu: CPU rises from approximately 1.2-1.3 cores to approximately 3.3 cores per four-core node. Work verification adds CPU load, but the evidence does not show all CPUs reaching four cores.
conclusion.not_new_work_generation: Work generation counters do not increase during the stall interval; new historical Work computation is not its trigger.
conclusion.queue_units: pending_block_verify counts transaction work units in queued/active block messages, not number of blocks.
code_evidence: Transaction/Block.h VerifyBlock synchronously calls WorkRules::VerifyDeltaProofs before updating block_verify_ms.
Consensus/WorkRules.h verifies each ticket in a block with the shared proof verifier.
Crypto/WorkProofVerifier.h prioritizes waiting block batches but does not preempt an active ordinary ticket.
Crypto/WorkElection.h VerificationCache::Check waits for an already active ticket through shared_future.get().
conclusion.trace_limit: No per-block VDF trace identifies the exact first ticket or distinguishes mathematical verification from waiting for that same ticket. Aggregate timing establishes the Work-verification phase and block-validation delay.

tps_review.conclusion: 5760.5486 TPS is the 26.3975-second recorded interval, not the complete requested 30-second interval.
tps_review.missing_boundary: There is no complete cluster transaction snapshot at second 32. The next full statistics sweep starts around seconds 29.1-30.3; common-chain RPC completion and line writing are delayed until second 35.456. The exact 30-second TPS cannot be recovered from these files.
tps_review.bug: LoadMetrics.Add rejects the 35.456-second line against the original end=32. The early-stop handler changes metrics.end afterward and does not add that line again.

latency_review.conclusion: All 600 samples scheduled during seconds 2 through 32 are retained. Median 413.7913 ms is reproducible and is not truncated by the late statistics line. The median sample completed before the stall.
latency_review.recording: included_at is when polling confirms inclusion. Slow RPC completion delays later sample timestamps; exact block arrival times are not separately recorded.

reorganizations_review.baseline_at_second_2: Snapshots bracketing second 2 have the same per-node counters, sum 772.
reorganizations_review.conclusion: At least 384 node reorganization events occurred within the requested 30-second measurement interval. The full recorded interval has 501. Exact second-32 counters are missing; nine undercounts the measurement.
reorganizations_review.counting: Sum of per-node reorganization counter increments; the same fork may increment multiple nodes.
reorganizations_review.maximum_depth_note: max_reorg_depth is lifetime cumulative and includes pre-test recovery; this evidence cannot assign its reported 35 to the load interval.

early_stop.reason: TPS below threshold and transaction backlog increased in consecutive windows
